evidence.quote: For over 20 years, StubHub has been the leading marketplace for fans to buy and sell tickets.
Buy sports, concert and theater tickets on StubHub!
Buy sports, concert and theater tickets on StubHub!
Includes ticket purchases for live entertainment, including concerts, live sporting events, live theatrical productions, amusement parks, and orchestras.

Entertainment purchases include ticket purchases at movie theaters, sports promoters (professional and semi-professional live events), theatrical promoters, concert promoters, amusement parks, tourist attractions, aquariums, zoos, dance halls, record stores, video rental locations, pool halls and bowling alleys.

draft.notes: StubHub’s stated business is a third-party ticket marketplace. The issuer definitions support entertainment for concert, sports, and theatrical tickets; Discover excludes some amusement-park tickets purchased on third-party sites, but not StubHub’s stated core ticket types.
